motion.purpose: Immediate press feedback; removed under reduced-motion preference.

extensions.provenance: Extracted from the implemented review surface; no generated or sourced shipping raster assets.

narrative.northStar: Compare a proposal with its evidence before changing a collection.
narrative.overview: A restrained source-linked editor with explicit local save, current quality evidence and exact approval.

rules.name: Inert evidence
rules.body: Source and card text are displayed as text, not executed HTML.

dos: Retain visible keyboard focus and honest saved/error state.
Stack editor before evidence at phone widths.
donts: Do not invent reviewer evidence or flatten uncertain partial application.
Do not hide the explicit existing-note update decision.
